adapters.system_description: Git-native economic system for on-chain repository credit
adapters.system_note: GITSEA is sovereign over its own credit decisions. Dan-Go does not push candidates to GITSEA. Dan-Go does not activate or confirm GITSEA credit.
adapters.observation_note: Dan-Go observes external credit systems. It does not operate them. Observation is not issuance. Candidate credit is not external credit.
